通过项目提供的 Agent 客户端接入；自己的伴侣人格和记忆需要另外配置。: Access through the Agent client provided by the project; your partner's personality and memory need to be configured separately.
OpenPersona：开放四层 AI Persona 框架，将灵魂、身体、能力: OpenPersona: An open four-layer AI Persona framework that splits soul, body, abilities and skills into composable assets, and is compatible with OpenClaw and the skills ecosystem. AI Companion Atlas Chinese project archive.

一台已经安装并登录 Claude Code 的 Windows、macOS 或: A Windows, macOS, or Linux computer with Claude Code installed and logged in, and a mobile phone.
手机聊天、查看工作过程、上传图片或 PDF，并确认是否允许改文件或运行命令。: Chat on your mobile phone, view work processes, upload images or PDFs, and confirm whether you are allowed to change files or run commands.

草履虫 Paramecium：网关式长期记忆架构，以逐字聊天记录为真源，向量仅作: Paramecium Paramecium: Gateway long-term memory architecture, using verbatim chat records as the source of truth, vectors only as indexes, and returning the original text rather than a summary replacement during recall. 1. 登录或填入 API Key: 1. Sign in or enter an API key
用账号登录时，DeepSeek GUI 会打开系统浏览器完成登录，然后回到应用；: To sign in with an account, DeepSeek GUI opens your system browser and returns to the app afterwards; account sessions use the account's credit, so no API key is needed. After sign-in, the official setup introduces your credit, asks what you plan to use it for, and lets you choose how much work detail to show. You can also enter an API key on the welcome screen or in Settings → Models. Harness stores credentials in the DeepSeek GUI data folder; they never go into the installer, the command line, or ordinary diagnostic logs.
「设置 → 账号与余额」显示账号、充值余额与赠金余额；「查询用量」和「充值」会在: Settings → Account shows the account and the topped-up and granted balances. View usage and Top up open the DeepSeek platform page inside the window, already signed in.
同一页下方是 DeepSeek GUI 的用量视图：今天、7 天、30 天的花费: Below it on the same page is DeepSeek GUI's usage view: spending, requests, tokens, and cache hit rate for today, 7 days, and 30 days, plus a 60-day activity heatmap. The data is read with the account sign-in, and the token never reaches any page.
账号卡片可能显示「账号资料暂不可用」，不显示昵称与头像；余额、用量与充值不受影响: The account card may show "Account details are not available yet" instead of your name and avatar. Balances, usage, and top-up are not affected.
进入会话后，可以在「对话」「轨迹」旁切换「改动」「Git」「项目管理」「记忆」。: Inside a conversation, switch between Changes, Git, Project management, and Memory next to Conversation and Trace. These views read local state directly, so refreshing them does not call the model.
按项目勾选这个文件夹下的会话可以使用哪些本地技能。: Choose which local skills the sessions in this folder may use.
阅读当前项目的 Markdown 记忆，或在增强记忆模式下查看、编辑、忘掉和恢复: Read the current project's Markdown memory, or in Enhanced memory mode view, edit, forget, and restore memory entries.
在「设置 → 全局记忆」中可以改用带版本的记忆条目。助手可以记下、更正、忘掉和检: Settings → Global memory can switch to versioned memory entries. The assistant can remember, correct, forget, and recall them, and each step injects only the entries relevant to the current content; you can view, edit, undo, and restore them. Markdown files remain the default, switching asks for confirmation first, and you can switch back at any time.
在「设置 → Skill」中可以从文件夹、ZIP 或单个 Markdown 文件: Settings → Skills imports skills from a folder, a ZIP file, or a single Markdown file. Each import is reviewed first: metadata can be fixed on the spot (only the library copy changes), and blocking issues stop the import.
会话顶部的「项目管理」页按项目勾选可用的技能：同一文件夹下的会话共用一份选择，没: The Project management tab at the top of a conversation selects the skills each project may use. Sessions in the same folder share one selection, unselected skills are invisible to that project, and the official skills keep working as before.
助手的命令或文件写入涉及 Windows 系统文件、已安装的程序或 DeepSe: When an assistant command or file write touches Windows system files, installed programs, or DeepSeek GUI's own code, a red approval card appears, even under Full access. Enter does not approve it, and focus starts on Reject. The check is heuristic, so paths written inside script files are not seen.
用户目录、盘符根目录和系统目录作为工作区时只读，不能开启完全访问或提权。: The user folder, drive roots, and system folders are read-only as workspaces, with Full access and escalation refused.
以管理员身份启动时会弹出红色警告；继续使用时禁用「完全访问」。: Starting as administrator shows a red warning; if you continue, Full access is disabled.
「工作区内修改」模式下写入: In Workspace Write mode, writes to
会被拒绝，暂存与取消暂存会先弹出审批。: are refused, and staging and unstaging ask for approval first.
模型、会话、凭据、权限、记忆和 hook 状态都由 Harness 管理。当前的: Models, sessions, credentials, permissions, memory, and hook state are all managed by Harness. The desktop launcher controls the current Harness Home and Profile; v1.1.2 embeds DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2.
插件在官方插件页管理：可以安装、配置、启停和卸载，安装时会检查与当前 Harne: Plugins are managed on the official Plugins page: install, configure, enable, disable, and uninstall them, with a compatibility check against the running Harness version. The plugins bundled with DeepSeek GUI appear under the "Bundled with DeepSeekGUI" group and cannot be removed.
无法访问 GitHub 时，会自动改从官网下载同一个安装包，并经过同样的 SHA: When GitHub cannot be reached, the same installer is downloaded from the official site instead and goes through the same SHA-256 and size checks.
v1.1.2 首次打开旧会话时会把会话数据转换为 V4 格式；转换后的会话不能再: v1.1.2 converts older session data to the V4 format when a session is first opened; converted sessions cannot be read by v1.1.1.
项目文件夹里的程序启动不了: Programs in a project folder will not start
用「工作区内修改」模式跑过 Windows 沙箱的文件夹，会被官方沙箱永久标记为: A folder where the Windows sandbox ran in Workspace Write mode is permanently marked Low integrity by the official sandbox, so programs started from it afterwards (for example an Electron development build) may fail to run. For symptoms and cleanup, see the
